criteria.text: Describe change provenance as supporting evidence only; no metadata-equals-regulatory-conformance guarantee. Verify legal applicability/date claims from current primary official sources and distinguish absent operational logging/disclosure/marking.
Distribution copy distinguishes deterministic checks, coordinator-owned reruns, worker-attested records and advisory native hooks.
Oncall field-proof plan targets OPERABLE and signals/alert receipt/induced failure/removal control with both blind oracle runs.

The generated test-count badge accurately presents source inventory rather than execution success. Failing and passing fixture suites must not be mislabeled as passing by static counting; retain correct count generation and strict freshness checks.
